fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Heading shown above the form, e.g. 'Watch the recorded webinar'

fields.name: recordingUrl
fields.label: Recording link
fields.description: Optional URL of the recording shown after the form is submitted

fields.name: message
fields.label: Message
fields.description: Text shown in the panel instead of a form, e.g. 'Recording coming soon!' notice. Leave the form ID empty to show only the message.
